description: The anonymous projection of a request or XRPC act/plan turn. Private caller responses and previews are never records.

main.description: Keys: <did>.<request rkey>, or xrpc.<iss>.<sha256(intent), base32 lower 26 chars>. source is a tagged request strongRef or provenance.

height.description: The journal height that answered it; absent when nothing was journaled (moved, unreached, invalid).

card.description: The exact card the turn offered, only when everything the turn read and wrote is public (the host's inPublic).

cardCid.description: CID of the exact offered card as a DAG-CBOR string; not a repository record CID.

offers.description: The cards the turn offered its author, verbatim, only when everything it read and wrote is public.

turns.description: When the call's text held several spells the host ran one turn each (as for a post): each turn's answer, in order; outcome.status is then `spells`.

request.description: The proven request this public answer answers.

provenance.description: The authenticated XRPC issuer and its idempotency key.
